title: habenaria magniscutata
intro: Habenaria magniscutata, commonly known as the 'Rough-leaved Habenaria' or 'Large-fruited Habenaria', is a species of orchid native to the Western Ghats in India. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, and research has uncovered its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as the ability to lower blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Habenaria magniscutata include its use as a cardiotonic and diuretic, helping to regulate heart rate and blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
